# UC26 — Proof of enforcement — live verdict on every use case

**Track:** demo  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  
**OWASP:** 🛡️ **OWASP ASI** — Threats: T8, T9 · Sections: §4.1.1, §8

## Buyer Story

Buyers shouldn't have to trust the chat reply — every enforcement decision should be visibly, verifiably proven on screen, not just claimed.

## PingOne Solution

Every tool call is tagged end-to-end with the triggering useCaseId and active vertical (chip, launcher, or attack sim; any agent mode), stamped onto the token chain, the PingOne Authorize decision, and the activity log. A client-side verdict engine compares what actually happened against each use case's declared evidence and expected outcome, then renders the result live.

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/use-cases","label":"Trigger any use case below and watch the verdict appear"}`
